busy: the session is already in a turn
internal: the server hit an internal error
effort_unsupported: this model takes no thinking effort
effort_not_declared: this model takes no `{effort}` effort; it declares {declared}
cwd_unusable: {path} is not a usable working directory
delete_busy: the session is running a turn; interrupt it before deleting
child_session: a child session cannot do that
writer_required: only the session's writer may write
memo_empty: this session holds no blocks yet
retention_bad: retention is neither chars nor blocks
no_archive: the session has no request archive
range_outside: blocks [{lo}, {hi}] are not one range of session {session}
no_cwd: the session row carries no cwd
no_session_row: the writer created no session row
child_delete: a child session cannot be deleted on its own
child_message: a child session takes no messages
memo_name_bad: a memo name is non-empty and has no spaces
config_set_unreadable: cannot read a rule set it names: {detail}
config_profile_duplicate: duplicate profile name in one root
config_profile_shadowed: the same profile name exists in a lower root
config_auth_header_bad: authHeader must be true or false
config_models_not_list: models is required and must be a list
config_model_not_mapping: model entry must be a mapping
config_model_duplicate: duplicate model id in this provider
config_effort_auto: auto is no rung a model declares
cmd_cdp: switch the working directory; later relative paths resolve from it
cmd_compact: fold the history into a checkpoint: `/compact 20k` keeps ~20k characters of tail, `/compact 18` keeps the newest 18 blocks, then an optional focus
cmd_effort: how hard to think: auto, or a rung the model declares (this session only, never stored)
cmd_memo: memos: list, history, add, mod, del; scope defaults to global
cmd_model: switch model and write it as the default (config file; a new session opens with it)
cmd_name: name the session (a branch inherits it; siblings do not see it)
cmd_prepare: prepend the terms and manifest of the workspace to this message; `/prepare <text>` keeps the text as the message
cmd_profile: choose the system-prompt profile a session opens with
cmd_resume: resume one of this project's sessions
cmd_switch: switch this session's model (stored on the session)
cmd_usage: this session's usage and bill, per model
notice_cwd_fallback: this directory cannot be a workspace; using the temp directory
notice_profile_after_start: the profile is fixed once a session starts
notice_nothing_to_compact: no session yet: nothing to compact
resume_empty_current: no session in this directory (Tab: every directory)
resume_empty_filtered: no session matches (Backspace to edit the filter)
resume_read_failed: the session list could not be read: {detail}
tree_empty_filtered: no block matches (Backspace to edit the filter)
